name: F3: A Shelf on an Elf
description: Rulebook Table 83 (p.407). A Shelf on an Elf Quest (Third Floor, The Over City) grinding complications, featuring the 404th revolutionaries and the Scolopendrini.

results.name: Strange coral-vine plants with blue pollen
results.description: Strange blue-and-yellow plants with vines that look like coral grow on the walls of several nearby buildings. The pollen produced by their flowers is a weird blue dust and is detailed under Quest Items (p. 406).

results.name: Scolopendrini burrow out to attack the 404th
results.description: Several revolutionaries from the 404th investigate a large hole in the ground when they spot the crawlers. While their response to the PCs depends on their relationship, it won't matter. Shortly after the crawlers are spotted, a cluster of hungry Scolopendrini burrows out of the ground. They attack the City Elves. Providing aid is up to the crawlers.

results.name: A growing cloud of smoke overhead
results.description: The Mobs are lining up for their chance to be killed by crawlers. As each dies, a puff of smoke collects into a larger and larger cloud overhead. Should be fine, right?

results.name: Rumbling ground and a collapsing wall
results.description: The ground beneath the feet of the crawlers begins to rumble and shift. Before long, it is extremely difficult for them to maintain their footing. Meanwhile, the wall of a nearby building begins to collapse on top of them.

results.name: A Goblin merchant hawking Goblin wares
results.description: The squeal of a rusty axle the next street over draws attention. A Goblin merchant dressed in dusty business attire pushes a tarp-covered cart down the road. If he spots the crawlers, he calls them and attempts to sell his Goblin wares. PCs with a Goblin Pass receive a discount.

results.name: The watching centipede statue
results.description: A statue of an enormous centipede, composed mostly of rebar and the concrete remnants of a highway bridge, towers more than 30 feet in the air. Spotty black paint covers portions of the statue, giving it a mottled look. Its gaze appears to follow the crawlers as they move.
